summary: Add controlled remote Naver login mode, operator grants, bounded login tools, SSH controls, and documentation.

tasks.title: Add controlled worker login mode
tasks.change: Add serialized login lifecycle, strict request policy, lock-release waiting, status and restart operations, worker KeepAlive.
tasks.effect: Login mode switches the owned profile in process and disallowed requests fail closed.

verification.risk_reason: The worker owns the browser profile and login network permissions; errors can launch competing Chrome or expose forbidden destinations.
verification.test_reason: Existing tests do not cover transitions, login POSTs, or logout blocking.
verification.subject: Worker login lifecycle and request policy
verification.procedure: Run focused runtime, worker, IPC, and launch-agent tests.
verification.pass_criterion: Transitions retain profile ownership, fail closed on timeout, and reject logout and non-allowlisted requests.

tasks.title: Require explicit login operator grants
tasks.change: Gate lifecycle and login tools behind browser:read plus login:operate; add local serialized grant command and explicit client scope selection.
tasks.effect: Existing paired devices receive no new capability unless an operator grants it locally.

verification.risk_reason: Scope expansion controls remote login and must be durable and explicitly operator initiated.
verification.test_reason: Current auth tests do not exercise scope grants or login tool access.
verification.subject: Login scope authorization and local grant
verification.procedure: Run auth, dispatcher, and client tests plus mocked grant CLI integration.
verification.pass_criterion: Default clients remain read-only; granted devices can renew selected scopes; failed saves do not report success.

tasks.title: Expose bounded login interaction
tasks.target: login controller and MCP result transport
tasks.change: Add bounded screenshot, snapshot, click, type, press, and navigate tools with memory-only refs and password refusal.
tasks.effect: Operators can inspect and interact with one owned login page without persisting secret page content.

verification.risk_reason: Screenshots and typed content are sensitive and IPC responses can exceed existing bounds.
verification.test_reason: Existing checks do not cover image transport, redaction, or password controls.
verification.subject: Bounded login interaction and secret handling
verification.procedure: Run login controller, runtime, MCP, IPC, and client unit tests.
verification.pass_criterion: Images are inline only, secret content is excluded from logs, password typing is refused, and oversized results fail predictably.

tasks.title: Add SSH controls and document operations
tasks.target: local socket CLI and operator documentation
tasks.change: Add start/end/status local IPC CLI and document workflow, scope, allowlist, recovery, timeouts, and password boundary.
tasks.effect: SSH operators can control the existing worker without launching Chrome or quitting it manually.

verification.risk_reason: The CLI controls worker lifecycle, while documentation defines operational recovery and security boundaries.
verification.test_reason: There is no current CLI contract test for worker login controls.
verification.subject: SSH CLI and operator contract
verification.procedure: Run CLI integration and affected unit/shell integration tests; inspect docs against schemas and behavior.
verification.pass_criterion: CLI validates operations, dispatches over the owner-only socket, and never launches a browser.

verification: npm test -- focused agent unit files
risks: Real iMac GUI/keychain and Naver login verification cannot be completed in this Linux workspace.
Password, 2FA, and passkey entry remain intentionally unsupported.
